title: Immersive Mechanic
description: A military-technical mod in the style of bronze steampunk, expanding the player's arsenal with industrial equipment, mechanical weapons, and steam-powered armored vehicles
body:
A mod whose aesthetic is based on combining mechanisms from different eras under the steampunk style, with military equipment from the turn of the 20th century


Progress requires both old and new resources for new alloys and mechanical components. Iron is the basis of structures, bronze is used for plating and hulls, and durobronze - for heavy armor plates

Time for fortifications! Defensive concrete is very durable, but it doesn't drop when broken, the only way to get it is to wet the dry cement and wait 20 minutes for it to dry, plan your defenses in advance! Wet concrete doesn't drop after getting wet!

Adapt your equipment: Although the basic mechanic uniform does not offer much protection, it can be enhanced with guard plates to protect against attacks and bullets, at the cost of mobility, or with a gas mask to protect against negative effects, at the cost of vision

Explore! Find the lost wreckage of an ancient war machine to obtain armored vehicle

New logistics - large-sized parts in crates are required for the restoration of an ancient tank have a carrying limit, but they can be transported by horses!

Cavalry is important: Logistic transportation, fast melee attacks with a bonus saber damage in heavy armor, or keeping your distance with a rifle

Wide possibilities with a small arsenal: types of ammunition - rifle cartridges: regular, incendiary, and poisoned; tank cannon: incendiary, high-explosive, chemical, and armor-piercing, use them wisely

Immersive system: Rifle and tank's light cannon are not perfect and have a slight delay before firing to ignite the charge. A tank that stands still for a long time will flatten the earth beneath it, and the driver and gunner can open the hatches for better visibility when using handheld weapons, building, or clearing a path without leaving the tank, but the tank will no longer protect against external damage

Warning: Not all crafts are yet displayed through the JEI system, all available crafts in the mod are described in the Patent Book
